title: Modul paketi
description: Contract 2 — what a module actually puts on the wire. Modules send packets, not individual measurements. Normal traffic carries only the thermal summary; the full 768-value frame is attached as evidence when the module's own threshold logic fires.

modul_id.description: {saha}-{pano}-{modul}. Every record in olcumler must repeat this same id; the collector rejects the packet otherwise.

zaman.description: Packet time, stamped by the module. UTC ISO 8601 with a literal Z.

olcumler.description: Measurement rows in olcum_kaydi format. May be empty in a pure heartbeat packet.

termal_ozet.description: What the module derives on-board from the 32x24 array so the full frame does not have to be transmitted. Absent or null if the thermal sensor produced nothing this cycle.

maks.description: Hottest pixel in the frame, Celsius.

maks_konum.description: Position of that pixel as [sutun, satir] — x first: sutun 0..31, satir 0..23.

bolge_ort.description: Mean temperature of the four 16x12 quadrants, in order: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Gives the detector coarse spatial context without the full frame.

termal_kare.description: Full frame: 32x24 = 768 values, row-major flat array, decimal Celsius. Index of pixel (sutun, satir) is satir*32 + sutun. null in normal operation — populated only when the module's on-board threshold logic detects something, as evidence for the operator.

modul_durum.description: The module's own health. This is what lets us claim the system does not die silently (scenario 7).

besleme.description: 'sebeke' = running on the 230 V auxiliary circuit; 'yedek' = mains lost, running on the supercapacitor. A 'yedek' packet is the loss-of-supply alarm the backup store exists to send.

sinyal.description: Radio signal strength towards the site gateway, dBm. Negative; weakening trend is an early warning for a module about to go dark.
